features.name: nsw_price_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of NSW price to NSW demand, capturing price pressure per unit demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous price-per-demand signal useful for linear margin separation.

features.name: vic_price_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of VIC price to VIC demand, capturing price pressure per unit demand in Victoria.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth ratio aiding linear separation between rising/falling regimes.

features.name: nsw_vic_price_spread
features.description: Difference between NSW price and VIC price, representing inter-regional price gap.
features.expected_model_benefit: Inter-regional spread is a strong linear predictor of directional movement.

features.name: nsw_vic_demand_spread
features.description: Difference between NSW and VIC demand levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Demand imbalance contributes a useful linear projection axis.

features.name: total_demand_load
features.description: Weighted average of NSW and VIC demand approximating total system load.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures overall system stress; smooth linear feature.

features.name: transfer_centered
features.description: Transfer flow centered at zero (subtracting neutral midpoint 0.5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered signed transfer flow gives linear SVM a directional axis.

features.name: log_nsw_price
features.description: Log-transformed NSW price to compress heavy-tailed price spikes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Log-scale prices align better with linear decision boundaries.

features.name: log_vic_price
features.description: Log-transformed VIC price to compress price extremes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tames skewness for smoother linear margins.

features.name: peak_period_indicator
features.description: Continuous proximity-to-peak score based on period (peaks near 0.5 in normalized period).
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth peak-hour indicator helps linear model handle diurnal effects.

features.name: price_demand_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between NSW price and NSW demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows linear SVM to capture multiplicative pressure effects.

features.name: transfer_demand_alignment
features.description: Product of centered transfer and NSW-VIC demand spread indicating whether transfer flow aligns with demand imbalance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite alignment signal informative for directional movement.

features.name: market_stress_score
features.description: Semantic composite assessment of overall market stress combining price elevation, demand load, and transfer extremity. Higher values indicate more stressed conditions where directional moves are more likely. Computed as a smooth weighted sum of normalized inputs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single interpretable severity axis for the linear SVM margin.
